- A shot on target is defined as any shot that would have entered the goal if not saved by the goalkeeper or a fielding player; shots hitting the post or crossbar are not counted as shots on target. Own-goal attempts are excluded from an individual player's tally.
- If Pulisic does not feature in the match (e.g. is not in the squad or is substituted before taking a shot on target), his shots-on-target count is 0 and "No" wins.
